title: PEP Engagement Event Envelope v1
description: Closed schema for a signed engagement event reported by a dApp backend. The normative validator is src/schema.js; this document is an interoperable description of the same contract.

key_id.description: Backend signing key version registered for this app. Enables rotation without downtime.

action_class.description: Utility class. A = high utility, B = medium, C = basic activity. Each class carries a hard weight ceiling.

action_id.description: App-defined milestone identifier within the declared class.

weight.description: Signed utility weight. Must not exceed the class ceiling (A=100, B=10, C=1) enforced by the verifier regardless of the signature's validity.

timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds at event creation. Verifier accepts only within +/- TIMESTAMP_WINDOW_MS of its own clock.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes (hex). Unique per app_id; claimed atomically (test-and-set) only when the full pipeline passes.

pioneer_uid_hash.description: Versioned keyed hash of the Pi UID: 'h1:' + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(backend_secret, NFC(UID))), secret >= 16 chars and never transmitted. The raw UID never leaves the backend. Legacy bare sha256 hex tags ([0-9a-f]{64}) are readable by registries but deprecated.

eligibility.description: Self-declared eligibility flags, signed by the backend AND cross-checked against the launchpad-side eligible-users registry.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over PiRC1-PEP-v1\n + canonical JSON of the envelope with the signature field removed.
